Lina explores in Da Nang, Vietnam, and accidentally finds a hidden market. The market is full of various local specialty goods and foods she has never seen before.

Lina should be curious about this market, but she actually feels disgusted. Why is this?

[Candidate Answers]

B. Lina finds that her favorite brand goods are not in this market.
